english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for “nobody” or “no one.”
This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that nobody is present or does something.
Use this specifically when none of the people are involved, meaning nobody.

examples.english: There is no one in the meeting room.
examples.jyutping: wui6 ji5 sat1 jap6 min6 mou5 jan4

examples.english: It’s so cold today that none of them wants to go out.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 gam3 dung3 mou5 jan4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
